mission: Migrate the complete legally usable vehicle fleets from CarX, Car Parking Multiplayer, and Real Racing 3 into Yardman's private vehicle-production pipeline. Do not cherry-pick a small hero roster.
non_negotiable_rules: Every discovered source vehicle enters the migration queue.
Do not silently reject a car for poor geometry, materials, missing dependencies, excessive cost, or incomplete LODs; keep it queued in an explicit repair/block state.
Preserve source identity and provenance. Do not cosmetically relabel one model as another.
Porsche-specific vehicles, bodies, branding, badges, and Porsche-specific source media are excluded until the owner explicitly changes the rights status.
Shared generic dependencies may be reused when they are not Porsche-specific.
Private source media stays outside public Git. Public Git may contain tools, manifests, measurements, generated original proxies, and non-media evidence.
No fleet integration may destabilize the main Android optimization lane or core island streaming.
No APK is produced merely because a vehicle batch completes.

source_fleets.scope: ALL vehicle families and their required vehicle-part/material/texture dependencies
source_fleets.migration_policy: all discovered vehicle families queued; variants remain separate until identity/dependency analysis proves they are duplicates or cosmetic derivatives

source_fleets.scope: ALL vehicle families and their required vehicle-part/material/texture dependencies
source_fleets.migration_policy: all discovered player, rival, traffic, service, police, truck and other vehicle families queued when they contain recoverable vehicle geometry

source_fleets.scope: ALL cars in the recovered catalog and all car-prefixed source bundles, plus required wheel/material/texture/interior dependencies
source_fleets.migration_policy: catalog-wide extraction; Crown catalog 218 is only a validated reference example, not the fleet boundary

source_fleets.scope: ALL recoverable cars and required vehicle dependencies from the owner's RR3 source
source_fleets.migration_policy: complete source reconstruction and vehicle inventory first, then queue every legally usable car; Porsche-specific entries are filtered rather than converted

batching.reason: large enough for throughput while keeping render evidence, provenance and failures attributable per car
batching.promotion: cars pass independently; one broken car does not block extraction/conversion of the rest of a batch

report_per_vehicle: exact commit/checkpoint containing public tooling/evidence and exact private checkpoint containing media
